title: AADAAMs Rubys
description: Brand new ores and a brand new shining RED gem... The Ruby!
body:
AADAAMS Rubys
The missing gem is finally here. Discover Rubies, craft powerful red gear, and face the Ruby Keeper.

💎 Overview
AADAAMS Rubys is a Vanilla+ expansion for Minecraft 1.21 (NeoForge) that bridges the gap in the mining progression. If you have ever felt that the game needs more variety in its ores without changing the core mechanics, this mod is for you.

We bring the long-awaited Ruby into the game, not just as a trading item, but as a fully functional material for a complete set of tools and armor. But be warned: obtaining these treasures might draw the attention of their guardian.

✨ Features
1. Ruby Tools
Upgrade your arsenal with a new tier of equipment. The Ruby tools are designed to fit perfectly alongside standard vanilla gear.

Fresh Aesthetic: A deep, crystalline red texture that stands out in your hotbar.

Full Toolset: Includes Sword, Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel, and Hoe.

Balanced Stats: Designed to feel fair and balanced within the vanilla game progression.

2. Ruby Armor
Don a full set of gleaming red armor.

Full Set: Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, and Boots.

The Look: Perfect for players who want a distinctive look without using dyes on leather.

3. The Ruby Keeper 👹
This isn't just a simple ore mod. To truly master the power of the Ruby, you may have to face the Ruby Keeper.

A hostile entity guarding the secrets of the Rubies.

Defeat the Keeper to prove your worth and obtain unique loot.

Challenge: Prepare your best gear before seeking him out!

⚙️ Installation & Compatibility
Loader: NeoForge

Game Version: 1.21

Dependencies: None (Standard NeoForge installation).

❓ FAQ
Q: Can I include this in my modpack? A: Yes, absolutely! Feel free to use AADAAMS Rubys in your curseforge/modrinth modpacks.

Q: Is this compatible with other ore mods? A: Yes, this mod uses standard NeoForge tags ensuring high compatibility with other Vanilla+ mods.

Found a bug or have a suggestion? Please leave a comment or report it on our issue tracker!
